text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing joint launch w/ LangChain + GatewayX + LambdaHW (marketplace + co-announcement). Target date Apr 18. Need: press schedule, demo script, marketplace listing readiness, HW logo approvals. Who's in? :rocket:

sam: 👍 can we do Apr 18. Question: demo env — should we use Dedicated or Hosted? latency-sensitive demo needs Dedicated GPU. Also need model pin (e.g., rwd-13b-quant) and region.

jin: eng: Dedicated is fine but we need 72h lead to provision reserved pool. Also need exact seq length and concurrency targets. What model size? 7B or 13B quantized?

maria: Let's go 13B quantized for balance. Target concurrency 8, max seq 1024. Jin — can you confirm infra plan by EOD tomorrow?

jin: Yes. Will sketch infra runbook. Also want to run KV cache warm-up script pre-demo. snippet:
```bash
./deploy_demo --partner langchain --gateway gatewayx --capacity dedicated --region us-west-2 --model rwd-13b-quant
```

leo: Solutions: I'll draft a 7-min demo script that shows: 1) multi-tool chain via LangChain, 2) Gateway routing fallback to smaller model, 3) hardware burst to Lambda nodes. Will share storyboard.

pat: Marketing: Need asset checklist and embargo dates. Also want joint blog + marketplace tile on the same day. Who owns the press release? Partners prefer to own co-auth. Also need approved logos by legal.

elaine: Legal: we'll need logo usage agreements from LangChain + Lambda + GatewayX. Please upload assets to drive: https://redwood.company/partner-assets (placeholder). Can't approve until we have signed MSA addendum — I'll ping partner legal.

maria: @pat can you capture marketing owner? Also what's the deadline for final assets?

pat: Owner: me (pat). Deadline for assets: Apr 8 EOD. Also design needs 3 banner options. Please send guidelines.

leo: Note: marketplace listing requires cloud marketplace SKU and a short demo video (30-60s). Can we get recording slot on Apr 11?

sam: Confirming rollout plan: announce -> marketplace live -> demo day webinar same week. 2-week lead for marketplace review. That pushes final approvals to Apr 4. Is that ok?

maria: :eyes: we need to reconcile deadlines. Suggest moving target announcement to Apr 22 if partners need more time. Thoughts?

langchain-team: langchain-team: We can do Apr 18 if demo infra is stable. Need a smoke test w/ our orchestration a week prior.

jin: We should run a partner smoke test on Apr 10. I'll provision a staging pool and share access.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging pool scheduled: start 2024-04-10T09:00Z. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/partners/interop-smoke

pat: Can marketing confirm embargo window? 48 hours ok?

elaine: Embargo ok for 48 hours. Also need to clear any co-branded claims about latency/cost with partner comms.

maria: Action items: Jin — infra plan by 1719890000 (tomorrow EOD). Pat — assets & banners by Apr 8. Leo — demo script by Apr 3. Elaine — legal lead outreach today. LangChain rep — smoke test confirm. We'll do check-in Tues standup. Thanks :rocket:

sam: Adding checklist to shared doc: https://docs.redwood/partnerships/interop-launch-checklist (I'll populate)

maria: :thumbsup: closing for now. Ping if blockers.
